How many customers do we have?.sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customers;

List all shippers..sql: SELECT company_name FROM shippers ORDER BY shipper_id;

Which employees are based in Sydney?.sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS employee FROM employees WHERE city = 'Sydney';

What is the phone number of Exotic Liqui.sql: SELECT phone FROM suppliers WHERE company_name = 'Exotic Liquids';

Who is the contact person at Alfreds Fut.sql: SELECT contact_name FROM customers WHERE company_name = 'Alfreds Futterkiste';

How many products are discontinued?.sql: SELECT count(*) AS discontinued FROM products WHERE discontinued = 1;

Which suppliers are headquartered in the.sql: SELECT company_name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'UK' ORDER BY company_name;

List the product names in the Beverages.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Beverages' ORDER BY p.product_name;

How many products does each category con.sql: SELECT c.category_name, count(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name;

How many products does each supplier sup.sql: SELECT s.company_name, count(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.company_name ORDER BY products DESC, s.company_name;

How many orders has each customer placed.sql: SELECT c.company_name, count(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY orders DESC, c.company_name;

Which product names were ordered in quan.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id WHERE od.quantity >= 40;

List order ids and customer company name.sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.company_name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE e.last_name = 'Fuller';

Which products are supplied from the Uni.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where s.country = 'UK' ORDER BY p.product_name;

For each shipper, how many orders did th.sql: SELECT sh.company_name, count(*) AS shipments FROM orders o JOIN shippers sh ON o.shipper_id = sh.shipper_id GROUP BY sh.company_name;

What is total order revenue per customer.sql: SELECT c.company_name, SUM(od.quantity * od.unit_price * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

What is the total number of order line i.sql: SELECT count(*) AS line_items FROM order_details;

What is the average unit price across al.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products;

What is the total freight charged across.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight), 2) AS total_freight FROM orders;

How many orders were shipped to Germany?.sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE ship_country = 'Germany';

What is the average quantity per order l.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity FROM order_details;

What is the total stock value across all.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(unit_price * units_in_stock), 2) AS stock_value FROM products WHERE discontinued = 0;

How many orders does each order status h.sql: SELECT order_status, count(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY order_status;

Count the customers by country..sql: SELECT country, count(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customers DESC, country;

How many orders were placed in 1997?.sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01';

Which orders shipped later than their re.sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date ORDER BY o.order_id;

What was the total number of line items.sql: SELECT count(*) AS line_items FROM order_details WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01';

Which orders were placed in the last qua.sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND o.ship_country = 'France' ORDER BY o.order_id;

Which orders have not been shipped yet?.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NULL ORDER BY order_id;

How many customers joined before 2020?.sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE joined_at < '2020-01-01';

Which employee placed the most orders?.sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee, count(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY employee ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1;

Which three products have the highest un.sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC, product_name LIMIT 3;

Which five customers placed the most ord.sql: SELECT c.company_name, count(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY orders DESC, c.company_name LIMIT 5;

Which product has the lowest units in st.sql: SELECT product_name, units_in_stock FROM products WHERE units_in_stock = (SELECT MIN(units_in_stock) FROM products) ORDER BY product_name;

What is the most expensive product per o.sql: SELECT p.product_name, od.unit_price FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY od.unit_price DESC LIMIT 1;

Which country has the most suppliers?.sql: SELECT country, count(*) AS suppliers FROM suppliers GROUP BY country ORDER BY suppliers DESC LIMIT 1;

Which employee hired last?.sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS employee FROM employees WHERE hire_date = (SELECT MAX(hire_date) FROM employees);

Which customer company names start with.sql: SELECT company_name FROM customers WHERE company_name LIKE 'Alfreds%';

How many distinct cities do our customer.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT city) AS cities FROM customers;

Which products are currently out of stoc.sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE units_in_stock = 0 AND discontinued = 0 ORDER BY product_name;

How many employees have someone they rep.sql: SELECT count(*) AS employees FROM employees WHERE reports_to IS NOT NULL;

Which customer countries placed orders s.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.country FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.ship_country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY c.country;
